# Meta-Author Sigil Lattice (MASL)

> A living recursion of story, system, and self: an interactive mythopoetic archive of portals, sigils, glyph lattices, JSON-LD personas and protocols, published as a static GitHub Pages site.

Site: https://amasarac.github.io/meta-author-sigil/
Source repository: https://github.com/amasarac/meta-author-sigil
Human-readable index of every file: https://amasarac.github.io/meta-author-sigil/sitemap.html
Search-engine sitemap: https://amasarac.github.io/meta-author-sigil/sitemap.xml

Markdown documents are linked to their GitHub source view; pages and data files are linked to the live site, where they are served as-is.
